# Vasubandhu

*316 – 396 · Indian · [Yogācāra](../movements/yogacara.md)*

Indian monk and philosopher, Asaṅga's brother: after a major Abhidharma treatise, he gave [Yogācāra](../movements/yogacara.md) its most concise texts, the Twenty and the Thirty Verses.
